note: Re-judged 2026-10-20 (independent judge, after d5af024e2a, e52de83fbd, f69b6cace8, d822d12769, 7f4f79d49e; HEAD 818c9edb34). Section 2.9: "If the responder's policy allows it to accept the first selector of TSi and TSr, then the responder MUST narrow the Traffic Selectors to a subset that includes the initiator's first choices." narrowSelectors still collects the (proposedI[0], proposedR[0]) intersections apart and puts them first, and closedSubset always keeps the first pair. e52de83fbd changes only the floor branch (Section 2.9.2 scope in use, answered when wholly inside a proposed combination); when it declines, ordinary narrowing with first choices first runs as before. TestNarrowingIncludesFirstChoice and TestRFC7296ResponderAnswersOnlyCombinationsItChose PASS with -race at HEAD. Verdict stands; ./le rfc check reports the row STALE on narrowChildSelectors/narrowSelectors, this entry replaces it.
